Recorded evaluation: 82.48% accuracy on 976 artist-disjoint held-out songs.
How to interpret this

“Artist Score” is 1 only if the normalized artist had a chart event before this song’s reference date. The percentage averages the 300 trees’ probabilities within a balanced research sample. It does not estimate a song’s commercial-success probability. The forest had the highest observed accuracy in the original comparison and was chosen for deployment after reviewing those results.

Model: random_forest_v1_deployment random forest · Inputs: tempo, loudness, duration, Artist Score · The app does not upload or retain your values.
HitPredict uses Million Song Dataset descriptors and historical Billboard labels. Exact matching and finite chart history may leave label noise.
